name: Greyceratops
source:
Greyceratops is a fangame of Snoot game where you'll play as Desco Nocido, a grumpy teen who will experience the biggest change of his entire life

Are you up for it?

[From [url=https://n7-studios.itch.io/greyceratops]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Greyceratops是一款Snoot游戏同人游戏，你将扮演德斯科·诺西多 (Desco Nocido)，一个脾气暴躁的青少年，他将经历一生中最大的变化

你准备好了吗？

[来自[url=https://n7-studios.itch.io/greyceratops]itch.io[/url]]
